    # Separator rows and columns divide the grid into independent panels.
    sep = 3
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep for v in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(len(grid)))]
    rb = [-1] + rows + [len(grid)]
    cb = [-1] + cols + [len(grid[0])]
    out = []
    marker = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep)
    other = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep and v != marker)
    for a, b in zip(rb, rb[1:]):
        rowout = []

            rowout.append(1 if len(marks) >= 2 and not joined else 5)
        out.append(rowout)
    return out
